d:
Hitchhiking from Uyuni, Bolivia, to Calama, Chile, turned into one of my toughest border-crossing experiences. Rough, unpaved roads, the cold of the Andes and a dust storm along the way made reaching Chile an adventure in itself.
In this video, I leave Uyuni behind and make my way towards the Chilean border, travelling through the wide-open landscapes of the high Andes. On a map, it looks like a journey between two towns in neighbouring countries. On the ground, the road conditions and weather tell a very different story.
